name: bg-neural
title: Neural Background
blurb: WebGL shader renders fractal neural-like patterns animated by scroll and…
description: OGL-based WebGL background with shader-based fractal animation. Responds to pointer position and scroll progress. Supports hue, saturation, chroma adjustments.
use_when: Tech-forward hero section with interactive shader background.
avoid_when: Low-end devices, no WebGL support, or performance-critical applications.
a11y: Purely decorative shader animation; no motion-reduced variant.
